mn39:10.2: Walking and sitting mindfully, with one's meditation object in mind.
mn39:14.8: ‘acchādeti, chadeti—to sustain (life)’: not in this sense in P.T.S. Dict.
mn39:14.13: ‘baddha—imprisoned’: not in this sense in P.T.S. Dict. See Sutta 19, para. 6. (bandha).
mn39:14.14: ‘bandhana—imprisonment’: not in this sense in P.T.S. Dict. Cf. Sutta 129, para. 10. (transfixing).
mn39:25.1: ‘Washed’—a brahminical term for ritual bathing. See end of Sutta 7.
mn39:26.1: A brahminical term signifying to them ‘knowledge of the three (or four) Vedas’.
